### Borea v0.6.18

A patch release with security fixes. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### Security

- The .NET runtime inside Borea is now 10.0.15, with the security fixes of November 2026.

#### Updates

- Avalonia 12.1.6, with fixes in its memory and resource handling.
- System.CommandLine 3.0.0 for the `borea` command line. The commands and options stay the same.

Full changelog: [v0.6.17...v0.6.18](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/compare/v0.6.17...v0.6.18)
